project: Smart Campus Crowd-Balancing and Space Routing Engine

splits.strategy: time-ordered: week 1-2 train, week 3 first half validation, week 3 second half test

Historical Slot Average (baseline).detail: weekday x time-slot historical mean / majority class, global fallback

Linear Regression + Logistic Regression.detail: plain one-hot block, softmax cross-entropy logistic classifier, no feature engineering

Ridge + MLPClassifier (selected).detail: Ridge alpha=0.01 (L2, tuned on validation), MLP (32,) ReLU+Adam alpha=0.001 seed=42

limitations: Synthetic field-survey model: real queues react to weather, exams and unregistered events.
Sudden rain pushes everyone indoors -> wait times can jump beyond the training range.
Unlisted student activities (society fair, career talk) create demand spikes the model has never seen.
Only 3 teaching weeks are covered; semester-start and exam-period behaviour differ.
Per-phase bottlenecks shown in the dashboard are structure-weighted estimates, not separate predictions.
